answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow effectively resists Sybil attacks. First, every agent must deposit $50,000 in collateral to join the network. Second, peer attestations build a permanent reputation score. Third, any detected malicious behavior triggers an automated slash of all staked assets. An attacker must endure a cost of $750,000 in bonds and 45 days of rigorous verification. This system acts like a massive, ancient cedar gate protecting a rare saffron harvest from the relentless, rising tide of fraudulent identities trying to flood the marketplace at once.
